swap_risks: CRITICAL SUPPLY VOLTAGE RATING: LM358DR2G is limited to 30 V max (32 V abs max, p.3) whereas TL082IDR supports up to 40 V (42 V abs max, p.9). Installing a 5.5 V CMOS part on a 12 V–24 V rail causes instant breakdown.

CAUTION BANDWIDTH & PHASE MARGIN: GBWP differs by 5.3x (LM358DR2G: 1 MHz p.6 vs TL082IDR: 5.25 MHz p.14); higher-bandwidth replacements can oscillate with capacitive loads or stray feedback capacitance without an isolation resistor.
CAUTION SLEW RATE DIFFERENCE: Slew rate differs by 33.3x (LM358DR2G: 0.6 V/µs p.6 vs TL082IDR: 20 V/µs p.16); check full-power bandwidth SR / (2π·Vpeak).

HIGH INPUT BIAS CURRENT SHIFT: Typical Ib differs by 692x (LM358DR2G: 45000 pA p.4 vs TL082IDR: 65 pA p.14); high-impedance sensor dividers (>100 kΩ) suffer severe Ib·R DC offset error when swapping from CMOS/JFET to bipolar inputs.

CAUTION QUIESCENT CURRENT SHIFT: Supply current per channel differs by 4x (LM358DR2G: 350 µA/ch p.4 vs TL082IDR: 1400 µA/ch p.15); verify battery budget and total power dissipation across all channels.
HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: LM358DR2G has a lower Vs,abs,max rating (32 V, p.3) than TL082IDR (42 V, p.9); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 32 V.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 43% higher on LM358DR2G (LM358DR2G: 212 °C/W p.3 vs TL082IDR: 147.8 °C/W p.10); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: TL082IDR requires Vs,min >= 4.5 V (p.9) vs 3 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (LM358DR2G: 0..70 °C Commercial (0°C to +70°C) vs TL082IDR: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to +85°C)); LM358DR2G cold limit only 0 °C, LM358DR2G hot limit only 70 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: LM358DR2G (onsemi, SOIC-8) and TL082IDR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because supply voltage Vs,max drops >=20%; GBWP differs 5.3x; slew rate differs 33.3x. Signal-chain deltas: GBWP 1 MHz (p.6) vs 5.25 MHz (p.14), supply ceiling 30 V (p.4) vs 40 V (p.9), Vos 7 mV (p.4) vs 6 mV (p.14), Ib 692x gap (45000 vs 65 pA). Primary bench gotchas to watch: LM358DR2G "CRITICAL ESD Trap: Standard onsemi LM358DR2G Is Rated ONLY 250 V HBM / 100 V MM (p.3)!" (p.3) and TL082IDR "Mixed Legacy SFAB vs Modern RFB Silicon Lottery Under Non-H TL082IDR (Table 9-1, p.28)" (p.28). BOM decision: Choose LM358DR2G when ultra-low supply current (350 µA/ch) is prioritized; choose TL082IDR when supply rails exceed 30 V (rated up to 40 V) or closed-loop signal bandwidth requires 5.25 MHz GBWP. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.5) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
